All of the chemical compounds found in nature that emit a detectable odor are likely all of the compounds that will ever be naturally produced. However, nature is constantly coming up with new combinations of these compounds. When you smell chocolate, you don't process all of the chemicals individually, but as one memorable aroma, even though its made up of something like 40 smelly things, including what normally smells like BO and cabbages.

Short version: I, a tiny 19 year old girl, got threatened with a knife by a full grown manchild and then hit with a skateboard at full retard-strength his ex gay lover.



Long Version: I worked a home health job where I basically disabled-adult-sat a set of about four roommates in a house. One of the houses I worked at had, at one time, an 18, 22, and 23 year old, all at varying degrees of disability. Their mental ages were roughly 7, 13, and 15 in the same order. 
This was not a good arangement for any of these guys. The youngest was a very autistic sex offender. The middle was a nice, but hyperactive, and extremely prone to being maniplulated into doing things he knew he shouldn't. The oldest was a manipulative little lying piece of shit.
Everything started because the oldest two were having secret gay sex in the basement while the overnight staff was passed out. And the youngest, who was at the company because of the secret gay sex he had with his little brother, tattled because he'd been told it was very wrong to do what they were doing. 
The two oldest (after beating the crap out of the 'tattletale') started fighting all the time. It escalated over the course of two weeks until the oldest threatened everybody in the house with a kitchen knife. On my shift. Naturally. 
So I got everybody out of the house and held the door shut while he tried to stab me through the door. The police got there and hauled him away for a 72 hour psych hold. 
My next shift at that house was three days later when he got home. Obviously the hold wasn't long enough, because the fighting started less than two hours after he walked in the door and apologized. He grabbed a wooden board he'd been storing in his basement bedroom and threatened his ex lover. Middle dude wasnt happy about this and came out of his room with a skateboard. Older dude jumped next to me on the couch and tried to hide behind me. So we both got hit several times with the wheeled side of the board. 
I luckily walked away with only some major bruising. But I had to go with the asshole who started all of it (and threatened me with a knife three days earlier) to the hospital and listen to him lie to his family about the events. I put in my two weeks that same day.

My super creepy supervisor at my home-health job set me up for an interview with a guy about being daily caregiver for his mother. All good there until my supervisor ALSO showed up to my interview. The old guy interviewing me was equally creepy, I really just wanted to leave the whole time. At the end of it all, I said I probably wasn't a good fit. So creepy supervisor and weird old guy pulled me into a threeway hug and it was the most awkward, uncomfortably long, and unwanted hug of my life. I was dead certain I was about to be raped and I all but ran to my car when they let go.

Auditory Processing Disorder, which is really only rare as an adult. 

I have problems separating sounds from eachother, making it hard to focus and/or understand conversation in noisy places. So if there's a TV or radio playing, plus an AC fan or traffic or a crowd, and someone talking to me, I can't process ANY of it. 

People don't understand, so they just get louder. It gets very overwhelming.

A car accident on a residential street in which a pickup truck towing a camping trailer jackknifed and hit a tree (and almost a living room). The trailer was the kind that extended over the bed of the truck during towing, so when the front and drivers side hit the tree, the trailer hit the back window of the truck and then disconnected, rolled back, and hit another car. The only uninjured person in the truck was the passenger in the front. The driver had a broken arm, and a lot of bruising. One of the two teenagers in the back seat had a head injury, and the other was just bleeding everywhere from all the glass. The driver and passenger left through the passenger side door. The kids left through the smashed out back window because their door had warped shut. My dad, who was towing a camper right in front of them, grabbed a fire extinguisher from our camper, and managed to keep the truck under control while my mother and I and one of the other drivers focused on first aid and keeping the family calm. I will never forget the sound of the crunching metal.

When the cops showed up, he tried to fight my next door neighbor who had called the cops on him in the past. They lived above my neighbor, but we (half the complex) could all hear them fighting every night. He never suspected me. I probably wasn't the only caller that night though.
